title: sparkxray tables manifest
description: The manifest.json beside one Spark application's Parquet tables: which files they were built from, how many rows each holds, and what the log was written without. sparkxray logs show --json prints it as manifest.

key.description: The SHA-256 naming the tables' directory, over each file's URI, ETag, modification time and size, the tables schema version and the installed sparkxray version.

row_counts.description: Each table's row count, by table name. Each table is <name>.parquet beside this manifest.

lacks.description: What Spark wrote only when asked, and this log was written without. stage_executor_metrics: spark.eventLog.logStageExecutorMetrics was off, so the per-task peaks are the only memory figures. block_updates: spark.eventLog.logBlockUpdates.enabled was off. process_tree_metrics: spark.executor.processTreeMetrics.enabled was off, so peak_python_rss_bytes is null. A log rebuilt from a server's REST JSON goes without four more. stage_parents: no stage names the stages it reads, so the simulation infers them. task_executor_metrics: no task carries the executor's peaks while it ran. task_accumulators: no task carries its accumulator updates, so plan_node_metrics holds the values the SQL tab displayed and node_stages is empty. execution_configs: no SQL execution carries the settings it changed, so a setting changed at runtime reads as the application's.

ingest.description: The ingest manifest of the log the tables were built from.
